app.title: Show HN: OmniDiff – Opensource, super fast, content aware Git difftool, in Rust
app.author: FabCH
app.description: A Rust implementation of a content‑aware Git diff tool that performs fast diffs with contextual awareness.
proposed_tests: Run omnidiff on a sample repo and compare output to git diff
Measure diff latency for a 50kB file
Verify content‑aware diff by editing a block and observing correct grouping
